config.resolution: full (one addressable pixel per node; 20-show-pixel grouping abandoned 2026-07-12)
config.pixel_count_basis: total_pixels = installed physical length × 10 px/m (PER_ARCH_PIXELS: 240/230/230/220/220). Finalized 2026-07-15 (strips installed). ~6-pixel crown overshoot (3 per curve) is blacked in the show.
config.note: pixel_positions and centerline are [z, y] in metres (z = horizontal across arch, y = vertical). pixel_polygons: 4 corners [[z,y],...] per pixel — rectangle along path (arc spacing) × across path (poly_width, arch ring depth). Adjust fudge_factor or PER_ARCH_FUDGE to add installation slack.
